inputs.scope: Train-only captured public rollouts; no gameplay evaluation.

limitations: Repeated timing seeds, not a learning-quality experiment.
Floating-point thread changes alter weights; exact continuation requires the saved runtime.
Initial non-deterministic matrix motivated a separate deterministic follow-up; order and thermal/background effects are not fully controlled.
Complete invocations use two order-reversed repetitions and include startup/recording/checkpoints/tracking/cleanup; no evaluation.
Larger KL batches and a rollout cache were not adopted; original stopping and skip calculations are retained.

profile.caveat: One cProfile diagnostic with overhead; epoch_measurement includes forward/preparation and is not additive to them.

protocol.scope: Two fresh CPU thread settings, two order-reversed repeats each, normal CLI recording/checkpoints/local MLflow; no research model promotion.

findings: Fresh CLI permits 1/2/4/8 learner threads; >1 requires strict deterministic operations.
Checkpoints bind thread count and enabled/warn-only determinism flags; normal private-state restore checks remain in force.
Saved settings are validated before configuration and explicit count changes reject.
Spawned collectors remain at one Torch thread; in-process collection shares learner thread count.
CLI restores caller thread/determinism settings on success and failures.
PPO/model math matches retained baseline; full-batch KL and zero-signal skip checks are unchanged.
Three deterministic four-thread probes match exact model fingerprints, Adam digests and shuffle RNG.
103 distinct focused tests passed after a test-only missing resume_path setup fix; no production fix was needed.
Frozen replay is an explicitly separate public-data benchmark and cannot start games or repin a stale corpus.
limits: Cross-thread weights differ; exact continuation is supported only with the same saved runtime.
Owner separately verifies complete CLI benchmark artifacts.
review.scope: CPU thread execution, determinism, same-runtime resume, CLI ownership, unchanged PPO/model math and bounded benchmark semantics
